html:
D140　第二十周复盘

第 20 周 · 5 小时。前置阅读为 D139-五十轮工单交接实验。本章使用 Node.js 20、pnpm 10、NestJS 12 与 PostgreSQL。

今天要做出什么

从一份第 50 轮的输入倒查三个事实。解释哪些来自工单系统、哪些来自历史、哪些只能在模型回报中看到。最后给同事做一次不调用模型的回放演示。 先遮住结果表，依次用下面三个问题口述交班：第 46 轮后哪几轮能逐字回看？旧手册的第 2 页还能否打开？“拒绝重启”应从哪条业务记录证实？ 动手变式把长手册的首段也移出提示，只保留版本引用。 再用 D139 的两种实测读数修正窗口边界，区分“能否发出”和“实际消耗”。

目录与时间

★ apps/server/src/agent/diagnosis.service.ts
★ apps/server/src/agent/handover-budget.spec.ts
★ apps/server/src/agent/handover-budget.ts
★ apps/server/src/agent/manual-page.spec.ts
★ apps/server/src/agent/manual-page.ts
★ apps/server/test/diagnosis.e2e-spec.ts

★ 为本次复盘变式修改的文件。复盘 40 分钟，动手与故障定位 110 分钟，指标核对 45 分钟，模拟面试 75 分钟，小结 30 分钟。优先完成必做用例，超时先跳过拓展。完整回归的等待时间另计。

零、闭卷回忆

D139　五十轮结束，怎样判断工单事实究竟丢在哪一层？

核对答案

先检查第 50 轮发送的任务块，再用工单号、决定、审批三个字段给真实回答分别评分。

D137　翻页途中手册改版，哪个值暴露变化？

核对答案

取当前可见正文的版本摘要，与翻页携带的 revision 比较，不一致返回 409。

D133　上周的哪项证据能分清批准和完成？

核对答案

审批记录绑定摘要；业务完成还需检查点以及唯一的业务效果或服务回执。

再复测错题本中今天到期的条目。

一、知识点与可运行示例

1.1 超过一页时只传引用

D137 已把手册保存在数据库，并能按版本翻页。本次把发送策略再收紧：超过 240 个码点时，模型只看到手册号、标题、版本和起始偏移；长度恰好等于一页仍可提供原句。用户查看原文时重新鉴权。

在 apps/server 运行 pnpm exec vitest run src/agent/manual-page.spec.ts -t "长手册只发引用而短手册仍给出原句"。下面的用例取自 apps/server/src/agent/manual-page.spec.ts，第四节列出本章源码；复用的夹具可按导入路径在前置讲义中查阅。

  it('长手册只发引用而短手册仍给出原句', () => {
    const page = (body: string) => ({ title: { text: '手册', clipped: false }, ...manualPage('m', body) });
    const long = page('磁'.repeat(241));
    expect(manualForModel(long)).toEqual({ sourceKey: 'manual:m', revision: long.revision, title: long.title, offset: 0 });
    expect(manualForModel(page('磁'.repeat(240)))).toHaveProperty('quote.text', '磁'.repeat(240));
  });

推导题　为什么这里的引用从 0 开始？

答案

模型还没看过第一页。把 next=240 当起点会让人工核对时直接错过最前面一页。

1.2 给实际窗口留出可说明的边界

本周同一份 raw 字符串在本地分词与 Ollama 的上报值之间出现 0 到 2 个 token 的差异。这个样本最大值不能当通用误差界。针对本机 TinyLlama 的字节回退，先按分词器分配各块，发送前同时检查原始 UTF-8 字节数加 8 个边界位置，取两者较大值再加输出预留。这样会提早移除部分仍可能装得下的历史。

在 apps/server 运行 pnpm exec vitest run src/agent/handover-budget.spec.ts -t "可选块按字节上界裁剪且独立报告分词数"。下面的用例取自 apps/server/src/agent/handover-budget.spec.ts，第四节列出本章源码；复用的夹具可按导入路径在前置讲义中查阅。

  it('可选块按字节上界裁剪且独立报告分词数', () => {
    const history = ['steady '.repeat(40)];
    const baseCost = packHandover(base).guardTokens;
    const plan = packHandover({ ...base, history }, baseCost + 30, 16);
    expect(plan.packed.history).toEqual([]);
    expect(plan.guardTokens).toBeGreaterThan(plan.inputTokens);
    expect(plan.guardTokens + plan.output).toBeLessThanOrEqual(baseCost + 30);
  });

推导题　为什么不直接拿字节上界估算费用？

答案

它是本模型的保守放行条件。实际用量按服务端上报；换分词器、正规化方式或模板时要重新建立边界。

二、自己动手

步骤 1　闭卷重建账本

提示一 · 方向

只看题目，不打开上一课的结论。

提示二 · API

从实验文件找 round 1、round 50、totals 与 recalls。

提示三 · 实现顺序

手算全量和窗口组输入总量差，再核对最终回答逐字段评分。

步骤 2　实现引用变式

提示一 · 方向

在组装资料时判断首段是否已被截断。

提示二 · API

manualForModel 接收已脱敏的第一页与 revision。

提示三 · 实现顺序

分别准备 240 和 241 个字，再验证 HTTP 回放里的长手册没有 quote。

三、自检与提交

手算全量和窗口组输入总量差，再核对最终回答逐字段评分。 保存一次失败输出，恢复源文件并给出同一个用例的通过记录。 保存输入、判定条件和观察到的输出。

闭卷口述 给同伴看的证据 判断标准
为什么第 50 轮仍知道审批结果？ D139 HTTP 用例里的 rejected 任务及 49 条相反的历史意见 能指出后端从哪条业务记录取值
全量组和窗口组消耗多少？ 同一份 50 轮记录的两组 totals 用同一类输入 token 作分子和分母，输出单列
一份 241 字的手册如何核查？ 模型回放里的 sourceKey、revision、offset 与手册第一页 回放无正文，读取第一页需重新鉴权
模型没有复述工单号，是谁丢了数据？ 第 50 轮的实际 prompt 与 reply 分清发送前事实保留与回答命中

用 15 分钟做第一遍口述，逐题再花 10 分钟从快照找证据，最后用 20 分钟互换工单号和审批结论重讲。把依赖提示才能完成的题记入错题本。

本机边界复测。 英文和中英混合表情两条提示都把容量保护值推到 1984，另留 64 个输出位置。两次实际输入分别为 508 和 513 token。各追加一个 ASCII 字节后，组装器都在调用模型前拒绝。与 D139 的五十轮相比，这两个输入的分词偏差方向相反，也说明不能靠固定补两个 token 处理所有材料。相同字符大量重复时，字节上界会明显高估实际输入。见两条边界记录。

反证 A　在 apps/server/src/agent/manual-page.ts 把 if (!page.quote.clipped) return page; 临时替为 if (page.quote.clipped) return page;，运行同一用例。原始失败输出如下。

AssertionError: expected { title: { text: '手册', …(1) }, …(4) } to deeply equal { sourceKey: 'manual:m', …(3) }

恢复后文件 SHA-256 与实验前相同，同一用例复测通过。

反证 B　在 apps/server/src/agent/handover-budget.ts 把 const guardTokens = guardedTokens(prompt); 临时替为 const guardTokens = inputTokens;，运行同一用例。原始失败输出如下。

AssertionError: expected 58 to be greater than 58

恢复后文件 SHA-256 与实验前相同，同一用例复测通过。

同一会话的 50 轮配对测量

每轮各跑全历史和滚动窗口一次，一共 100 次本机 TinyLlama 推理。前 49 轮要求模型确认接收，最后一轮自由填写三个字段。规范历史统一使用窗口组的回答。

四、本章完整源码

apps/server/src/agent/diagnosis.service.ts

import { manualForModel } from './manual-page.js';
import { diagnosisMessages } from './diagnosis-context.js';
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { z } from 'zod';
import type { AuthUser } from '../auth/auth.types.js';
import { ModelGateway } from '../assistant/model-gateway.js';
import { parseToolReply } from '../assistant/tool-protocol.js';
import { UsageMeter } from '../assistant/usage-meter.js';
import { issueGrant } from './diagnosis-grant.js';
import { definitions, type Name } from './tool-catalog.js';
import { TicketToolsService } from './ticket-tools.service.js';
import { RunExecutorService } from './run-executor.service.js';

export const diagnosisSchema = z.object({ category: z.enum(['network', 'storage', 'power', 'unknown']) }).strict();
const checks = { network: '核对链路状态与丢包记录', storage: '核对磁盘容量与增长记录',
  power: '核对供电与电源告警', unknown: '补充发生时间和设备告警' };

@Injectable()
export class DiagnosisService {
  constructor(private readonly executor: RunExecutorService, private readonly tools: TicketToolsService,
    private readonly gateway: ModelGateway) {}

  async execute(user: AuthUser, id: string, manualId?: string) {
    const evidence: unknown[] = [];
    let pending = 'ticket_summary';
    let expanded = false;
    let grant: object | undefined;
    return this.executor.execute(user, id, async (step, context) => {
      const topic = /历史|记录/.test(context.goal) ? 'history' : 'device';
      const allowedTools = definitions(topic);
      grant ??= issueGrant(user.id, id, ['ticket_summary', ...allowedTools.map(tool => tool.name as Name)]);
      const signal = AbortSignal.timeout(step.deadlineMs);
      if (pending) {
        const name = pending;
        pending = '';
        const args = name.endsWith('_page') ? { limit: 3, after: null } : {};
        const call = { name, version: 1, args };
        const [result] = await this.tools.batch(user, id, [call], signal, false, grant);
        evidence.push(result);
        const failure = !result?.ok && name === 'ticket_summary' ? 'TICKET_READ_FAILED' : undefined;
        return { phase: 'tool', summary: name, tokens: 0, failure,
          trace: { kind: 'tool', input: JSON.stringify(call), output: JSON.stringify(result) } };
      }
      const available = expanded ? [] : allowedTools;
      const names = available.map(t => t.name);
      // 撤权时连失败 Trace 也不保存这批旧材料。
      let document: Awaited<ReturnType<TicketToolsService['manual']>> | undefined;
      try {
        await this.tools.owned(user, id, true);
        if (manualId) document = await this.tools.manual(user, id, manualId);
      }
      catch {
        return { phase: 'tool', summary: '重新核对工单权限失败', tokens: 0,
          failure: 'TICKET_ACCESS_UNAVAILABLE', failureReason: 'tool_failed' };
      }
      const packet = await this.tools.saveContext(user, id, step.ordinal, diagnosisMessages(available, { ...context, evidence, document: document && manualForModel(document) }));
      const messages = packet.messages;
      const traceInput = messages.map(message => message.content).join('\n');
      const meter = new UsageMeter();
      let output = '';
      try {
        const schema = expanded ? diagnosisSchema : z.union([diagnosisSchema, z.object({ tool: z.enum(names) }).strict()]);
        const raw = await this.gateway.complete(messages,
          signal, 'default', Math.min(step.deadlineMs, 5000), { type: 'json_schema',
            json_schema: { name: 'diagnosis', strict: true, schema: z.toJSONSchema(schema) } }, meter);
        const reply = parseToolReply(raw);
        if (reply.kind !== 'answer') throw new Error('DIAGNOSIS_INVALID');
        output = reply.text;
        const choice = schema.parse(JSON.parse(output));
        const usage = meter.summary();
        const trace = { kind: 'model' as const, input: traceInput, output,
          inputTokens: usage.inputTokens, outputTokens: usage.outputTokens };
        const tokens = usage.inputTokens + usage.outputTokens;
        if ('tool' in choice) {
          if (expanded || !names.includes(choice.tool)) throw new Error('DIAGNOSIS_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE');
          expanded = true; pending = choice.tool;
          return { phase: 'plan', summary: '选择补查工具', tokens, trace };
        }
        return { phase: 'answer', summary: '分诊与核查建议', answer: choice.category + ' · ' + checks[choice.category], tokens, trace };
      } catch {
        const usage = meter.summary();
        return { phase: 'answer', summary: '模型未给出有效分诊', tokens: usage.inputTokens + usage.outputTokens,
          failure: 'DIAGNOSIS_MODEL_FAILED', failureReason: 'model_failed',
          trace: { kind: 'model', input: traceInput, output, inputTokens: usage.inputTokens, outputTokens: usage.outputTokens } };
      }
    });
  }
}

apps/server/src/agent/handover-budget.spec.ts

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { countTokens, packHandover, type HandoverInput } from './handover-budget.js';

const base: HandoverInput = { policy: 'Use only ticket evidence.', task: { ticketNo: 'T-7', decision: 'hold', approval: 'waiting' },
  question: '当前进展？', history: [], documents: [], results: [] };

describe('输入和输出共享模型窗口', () => {
  it('必需块差一个 token 也不能挤占输出', () => {
    const exact = packHandover(base).guardTokens;
    expect(packHandover(base, exact + 16, 16).guardTokens).toBe(exact);
    expect(() => packHandover(base, exact + 15, 16)).toThrow('CONTEXT_REQUIRED_TOO_LARGE');
    expect(countTokens('Hello world!')).toBe(4);
  });

  it('可选块按字节上界裁剪且独立报告分词数', () => {
    const history = ['steady '.repeat(40)];
    const baseCost = packHandover(base).guardTokens;
    const plan = packHandover({ ...base, history }, baseCost + 30, 16);
    expect(plan.packed.history).toEqual([]);
    expect(plan.guardTokens).toBeGreaterThan(plan.inputTokens);
    expect(plan.guardTokens + plan.output).toBeLessThanOrEqual(baseCost + 30);
  });

  it('按区块限制历史同时保持最近轮次', () => {
    const history = Array.from({ length: 50 }, (_, i) => 'round ' + i + ' ' + 'disk check '.repeat(10));
    const result = packHandover({ ...base, history });
    expect(result.packed.history.length).toBeLessThan(history.length);
    expect(result.packed.history.at(-1)).toBe(history.at(-1));
    expect(result.packed.task.ticketNo).toBe('T-7');
  });
});

apps/server/src/agent/handover-budget.ts

import tokenizer from 'llama-tokenizer-js';

export const modelProfile = { name: 'tinyllama:latest', window: 2048, output: 64 } as const;
export const countTokens = (text: string) => tokenizer.encode(text).length;
// TinyLlama 的 raw 提示走 LLaMA 字节回退。按原始 UTF-8 字节另留 8 个位置给边界标记。
// 该上界仅用于放行判断；展示与成本对照仍保留分词器读数和模型回报。
function guardedTokens(prompt: string) {
  return Math.max(countTokens(prompt), Buffer.byteLength(prompt, 'utf8') + 8);
}
export interface HandoverInput {
  policy: string;
  task: { ticketNo: string; decision: string; approval: string };
  question: string;
  history: readonly string[];
  documents: readonly string[];
  results: readonly string[];
  summary?: string;
}

// 实验走 Ollama raw 模式。计数和发送使用同一份字符串，模型端不会再套模板。
export function rawPrompt(input: HandoverInput) {
  const { policy, ...material } = input;
  return policy + '\nDATA ' + JSON.stringify(material) + '\nAnswer briefly:';
}

function suffixWithin(items: readonly string[], budget: number) {
  const selected: string[] = [];
  for (const item of [...items].reverse()) {
    if (countTokens(JSON.stringify([item, ...selected])) > budget) break;
    selected.unshift(item);
  }
  return selected;
}

export function packHandover(input: HandoverInput, window: number = modelProfile.window, output: number = modelProfile.output) {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(window) || !Number.isSafeInteger(output) || output < 1 || window > modelProfile.window || output >= window) {
    throw new Error('CONTEXT_BUDGET_INVALID');
  }
  const packed = { ...input, history: suffixWithin(input.history, 400),
    documents: suffixWithin(input.documents, 256), results: suffixWithin(input.results, 384) };
  // 区块上限约束单一来源，再按实际序列化总长挤出低优先级材料。
  for (const items of [packed.history, packed.documents, packed.results]) {
    while (items.length && guardedTokens(rawPrompt(packed)) + output > window) items.shift();
  }
  const prompt = rawPrompt(packed);
  const inputTokens = countTokens(prompt);
  const guardTokens = guardedTokens(prompt);
  if (guardTokens + output > window) throw new Error('CONTEXT_REQUIRED_TOO_LARGE');
  return { prompt, inputTokens, guardTokens, output, packed };
}

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { manualForModel, manualPage } from './manual-page.js';

describe('手册按引用读取', () => {
  it('两页拼回脱敏正文且不切断表情', () => {
    const text = '盘'.repeat(239) + '📦结束';
    const first = manualPage('m', text);
    expect(first.next).toBe(240);
    const second = manualPage('m', text, first.next!, first.revision);
    expect(second.next).toBeNull();
    expect(first.quote.text + second.quote.text).toBe(text);
  });

  it('长手册只发引用而短手册仍给出原句', () => {
    const page = (body: string) => ({ title: { text: '手册', clipped: false }, ...manualPage('m', body) });
    const long = page('磁'.repeat(241));
    expect(manualForModel(long)).toEqual({ sourceKey: 'manual:m', revision: long.revision, title: long.title, offset: 0 });
    expect(manualForModel(page('磁'.repeat(240)))).toHaveProperty('quote.text', '磁'.repeat(240));
  });

  it('过期版本与越界游标分别拒绝', () => {
    const ref = manualPage('m', '旧文');
    expect(() => manualPage('m', '新文', 0, ref.revision)).toThrow('MANUAL_VERSION_CHANGED');
    expect(() => manualPage('m', '旧文', 3, ref.revision)).toThrow('MANUAL_OFFSET_INVALID');
  });
});

apps/server/src/agent/manual-page.ts

import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { ConflictException, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { redactForLog } from '../common/sensitive.js';

// 对脱敏后的正文按 Unicode 码点分页，引用指向固定版本，翻页不占模型上下文。
export function manualPage(id: string, body: string, offset = 0, expected?: string) {
  const text = redactForLog(body);
  const revision = createHash('sha256').update(text).digest('hex');
  if (expected !== undefined && expected !== revision) throw new ConflictException('MANUAL_VERSION_CHANGED');
  const points = Array.from(text);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(offset) || offset < 0 || offset > points.length) throw new BadRequestException('MANUAL_OFFSET_INVALID');
  const end = Math.min(offset + 240, points.length);
  return { sourceKey: 'manual:' + id, revision, quote: { text: points.slice(offset, end).join(''), clipped: end < points.length },
    next: end < points.length ? end : null };
}

// 长手册只把引用交给诊断模型。人工打开引用时仍从第一页校验权限和版本。
export function manualForModel(page: ReturnType<typeof manualPage> & { title: { text: string; clipped: boolean } }) {
  if (!page.quote.clipped) return page;
  return { sourceKey: page.sourceKey, revision: page.revision, title: page.title, offset: 0 };
}

import type { INestApplication } from '@nestjs/common';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';

import request from 'supertest';
import { vi } from 'vitest';
import { AppModule } from '../src/app.module.js';
import { configureApp } from '../src/app.setup.js';
import { TicketToolsService } from '../src/agent/ticket-tools.service.js';
import { ModelGateway } from '../src/assistant/model-gateway.js';
import { PrismaService } from '../src/prisma/prisma.service.js';
import { TicketFixtures } from './fixtures.js';
import { tokenIssuer } from './auth.js';
import { cases, score, type Trial } from './diagnosis-eval.js';

describe('工单诊断基线', () => {
  let app: INestApplication;
  let db: PrismaService;
  let fixtures: TicketFixtures;
  let auth: (name: string) => string;
  beforeAll(async () => {
    const module = await Test.createTestingModule({ imports: [AppModule] }).compile();
    app = module.createNestApplication();
    configureApp(app);
    await app.init();
    db = app.get(PrismaService);
    fixtures = new TicketFixtures(db, 'DIA');
    auth = await tokenIssuer(app);
  });
  afterEach(() => { vi.restoreAllMocks(); vi.unstubAllEnvs(); });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await db.agentRun.deleteMany({ where: { ticketNo: { startsWith: 'DIA' } } });
    await fixtures.cleanup();
    await app.close();
  });

  async function run(description: string, manualId?: string) {
    const ticket = await fixtures.create();
    await db.ticket.update({ where: { id: ticket.id }, data: { description } });
    const api = request(app.getHttpServer());
    const created = await api.post('/api/agent/runs').set('authorization', auth('bob')).send({
      ticketNo: ticket.ticketNo, goal: '判断故障类别并建议下一项核查', requestKey: randomUUID(),
    }).expect(201);
    const path = '/api/agent/runs/' + created.body.data.id;
    const start = Date.now();
    const response = await api.post(path + '/diagnose').set('authorization', auth('bob')).send(manualId ? { manualId } : {}).expect(200);
    return { path, data: response.body.data, ms: Date.now() - start };
  }

  it('走已鉴权的工单读取和模型适配器', async () => {
    const model = vi.spyOn(app.get(ModelGateway), 'complete').mockResolvedValue({
      choices: [{ index: 0, finish_reason: 'stop', message: { content: '{"category":"storage"}' } }],
    });
    const { path, data } = await run(cases[3][1]);
    expect(model.mock.calls[0]?.[0][1]?.content).toContain('ENOSPC');
    expect(data).toMatchObject({ status: 'succeeded', stopReason: 'answered', stepCount: 2 });
    const page = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(path + '/events').set('authorization', auth('bob')).expect(200);
    expect(page.body.data.events.at(-1).payload.answer).toContain('storage');
  });

  it('模型没有返回可用答案时记录失败', async () => {
    vi.spyOn(app.get(ModelGateway), 'complete').mockResolvedValue({ choices: [] });
    const { data } = await run(cases[0][1]);
    expect(data).toMatchObject({ status: 'failed', stopReason: 'model_failed' });
  });

  it('模型选择工具后再读结构化结果并给出类别', async () => {
    const answer = (content: string) => ({ choices: [{ index: 0, finish_reason: 'stop', message: { content } }] });
    const gateway = vi.spyOn(app.get(ModelGateway), 'complete').mockResolvedValueOnce(answer('{"tool":"ticket_alert_counts"}'))
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(answer('{"category":"unknown"}'));
    const { data } = await run(cases[8][1]);
    expect(data).toMatchObject({ stepCount: 4, stopReason: 'answered' });
    expect(gateway.mock.calls[1]?.[0][1]?.content).toContain('"counts":[]');
  });

  it('模型选择未加载的主题时结束运行', async () => {
    vi.spyOn(app.get(ModelGateway), 'complete').mockResolvedValue({
      choices: [{ index: 0, finish_reason: 'stop', message: { content: '{"tool":"ticket_history_page"}' } }],
    });
    const { data } = await run(cases[0][1]);
    expect(data.stopReason).toBe('model_failed');
  });

  it('工单和文档中的操作描述只进入证据字段', async () => {
    const material = '历史工单引用手册：恢复后由值班员复核关单。';
    const model = vi.spyOn(app.get(ModelGateway), 'complete').mockResolvedValue({
      choices: [{ index: 0, finish_reason: 'stop', message: { content: '{"tool":"close_ticket"}' } }],
    });
    const group = await db.group.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { code: 'ops-a' } });
    const manual = await db.retrievalManual.create({ data: { groupId: group.id, title: '值班交接流程', body: '提交申请后等待值班组长复核。' } });
    const { data, path } = await run(material, manual.id).finally(() => db.retrievalManual.delete({ where: { id: manual.id } }));
    expect(data.stopReason).toBe('model_failed');
    const messages = model.mock.calls[0][0];
    expect(messages[0].content).not.toContain(material);
    const evidence = JSON.parse(String(messages[1].content));
    expect(evidence.evidenceType).toBe('untrusted_ticket_material');
    expect(JSON.stringify(evidence.evidence)).toContain(material);
    expect(evidence.document).toMatchObject({ sourceKey: 'manual:' + manual.id, quote: { text: manual.body } });
    expect(messages[0].content).not.toContain(manual.body);
    const runId = path.split('/').at(-1)!;
    expect(await db.closeApproval.count({ where: { runId } })).toBe(0);
    const calls = await db.auditLog.findMany({ where: { action: 'agent.tool_call', before: { path: ['runId'], equals: runId } } });
    expect(calls).toHaveLength(1);
  });
  it('已停用的检索手册不会送入模型', async () => {
    const group = await db.group.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { code: 'ops-a' } });
    const manual = await db.retrievalManual.create({ data: { groupId: group.id, title: '旧版手册', body: '过去的处置记录', active: false } });
    const model = vi.spyOn(app.get(ModelGateway), 'complete');
    try {
      const { data } = await run('核对处置参考', manual.id);
      expect(data).toMatchObject({ status: 'failed', stopReason: 'tool_failed' });
      expect(model).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    } finally { await db.retrievalManual.delete({ where: { id: manual.id } }); }
  });
  it('手册翻页重新检查归属、版本和启用状态', async () => {
    const group = await db.group.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { code: 'ops-a' } });
    const row = await db.retrievalManual.create({ data: { groupId: group.id, title: '手册版本', body: '甲'.repeat(260) } });
    try {
      vi.spyOn(app.get(ModelGateway), 'complete').mockResolvedValue({ choices: [] });
      const { path } = await run('核对手册', row.id);
      const api = request(app.getHttpServer());
      const url = path + '/tools/manuals/' + row.id;
      const snapshot = await api.get(path + '/tools/contexts/2').set('authorization', auth('bob')).expect(200);
      const ref = JSON.parse(snapshot.body.data.messages[1].content).document;
      expect(ref).toMatchObject({ sourceKey: 'manual:' + row.id, offset: 0 });
      expect(ref).not.toHaveProperty('quote');
      const first = await api.get(url).set('authorization', auth('bob')).expect(200);
      const cursor = { revision: first.body.data.revision, offset: first.body.data.next };
      await api.get(url).query(cursor).set('authorization', auth('alice')).expect(404);
      const second = await api.get(url).query(cursor).set('authorization', auth('bob')).expect(200);
      expect(second.body.data.quote.text).toBe('甲'.repeat(20));
      await db.retrievalManual.update({ where: { id: row.id }, data: { body: '替换后的正文' } });
      await api.get(url).query(cursor).set('authorization', auth('bob')).expect(409);
      await db.retrievalManual.update({ where: { id: row.id }, data: { active: false } });
      await api.get(url).set('authorization', auth('bob')).expect(404);
    } finally { await db.retrievalManual.delete({ where: { id: row.id } }); }
  });

  it('回放接口返回送入网关的完整脱敏消息', async () => {
    const gateway = vi.spyOn(app.get(ModelGateway), 'complete').mockResolvedValue({ choices: [] });
    const { path } = await run('诊断记录 Bearer sample-opaque');
    const api = request(app.getHttpServer());
    const route = path + '/tools/contexts/2';
    const replay = await api.get(route).set('authorization', auth('bob')).expect(200);
    expect(replay.body.data.messages).toEqual(gateway.mock.calls[0]![0]);
    expect(JSON.stringify(replay.body.data.messages)).not.toContain('sample-opaque');
    await api.get(route).set('authorization', auth('alice')).expect(404);
    await api.get(path + '/tools/contexts/1').set('authorization', auth('bob')).expect(404);
  });

  it('工单转出班组后不再把已读取的材料发给模型', async () => {
    const tools = app.get(TicketToolsService);
    const batch = tools.batch.bind(tools);
    const target = await db.group.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { code: 'ops-b' } });
    vi.spyOn(tools, 'batch').mockImplementationOnce(async (...args) => {
      const result = await batch(...args);
      const row = await db.agentRun.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: args[1] } });
      await db.ticket.update({ where: { ticketNo: row.ticketNo }, data: { groupId: target.id } });
      return result;
    });
    const model = vi.spyOn(app.get(ModelGateway), 'complete');
    const { data } = await run('磁盘容量复核');
    expect(data).toMatchObject({ status: 'failed', stopReason: 'tool_failed' });
    expect(model).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
  it.skipIf(process.env.OPS_REAL_DIAGNOSIS !== '1')('本机模型逐项评测', async () => {
    vi.stubEnv('LLM_BASE_URL', 'http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1');
    vi.stubEnv('LLM_API_KEY', 'local-ollama');
    vi.stubEnv('LLM_MODEL', 'tinyllama:latest');
    vi.stubEnv('LLM_MODEL_ROUTES', '');
    const trials: Trial[] = [];
    for (const [id, description] of cases) {
      const { data, path, ms } = await run(description);
      const api = request(app.getHttpServer());
      const trace = await api.get(path + '/traces').set('authorization', auth('bob')).expect(200);
      const events = await api.get(path + '/events').set('authorization', auth('bob')).expect(200);
      const answer = events.body.data.events.at(-1).payload.answer as string | null;
      const usage = trace.body.data.usage;
      trials.push({ id, predicted: answer?.split(' · ')[0] ?? null, reason: data.stopReason,
        steps: data.stepCount, ms, tokens: usage.inputTokens + usage.outputTokens });
    }
    const report = score(trials);
    console.info('本机诊断基线', JSON.stringify(report));
    if (process.env.D111_EVIDENCE_FILE) appendFileSync(process.env.D111_EVIDENCE_FILE,
      JSON.stringify({ case: 'diagnosis', model: 'tinyllama:latest', ...report }) + '\n');
    expect(report.total).toBe(10);
  }, 120_000);
});
